unit.goal: `median` in stats.py returns the wrong value for lists of even length. Make it return the mean of the two middle values for even length, and raise ValueError for an empty list.

criteria.text: For a list of even length, median returns the mean of the two middle values.
For an empty list, median raises ValueError.
The tests include a case that fails on the original code and passes on the change.
